sentences.text: Saving Private Ryan is a 1998 American epic war drama film set during the Invasion of Normandy in World War II .	epic	epic film	war	war film	drama film	drama film	Invasion of Normandy	Invasion of Normandy	World War II	World War II

Directed by Steven Spielberg and written by Robert Rodat , the film is notable for its graphic portrayal of war , and for the intensity of its opening 27 minutes , which includes a depiction of the Omaha Beach assault during the Normandy landings . The film received critical acclaim , winning several awards for film , cast , and crew , as well as earning significant returns at the box office .
The film grossed US$ 481.8 million worldwide , making it the second-highest-grossing film of the year .

The film was nominated for 11 Academy Awards ; Spielberg 's direction won his second Academy Award for Best Director , with four more awards going to the film .	Academy Awards	Academy Awards	Academy Award for Best Director	Academy Award for Best Director
